description:
[Filings Oracle] Proof of real-time: seconds since the last successful SEC poll, age of the newest filing, median and p95 ingest lag (from SEC acceptance time) over the last 200 live filings, last successful poll per form type, and rows stored - Free. Proof of real-time: seconds since the last successful SEC poll, age of the newest filing, median and p95 ingest lag (from SEC acceptance time) over the last 200 live filings, last successful poll per form type, and rows stored.

**Example:** `/v1/freshness`

Use when you want proof the SEC feed is live: seconds since the last poll and ingest lag. Not for the filings themselves (use filings_search).

Behavior: read-only and free; no key or payment needed.
name: filings_freshness
